填入接入点后，将同时开启 MCP 服务和小智连接。: Enter an endpoint to enable both the MCP service and Xiaozhi connection.
已连接小智云端。可返回控制台查看工具是否已加载。: Connected to Xiaozhi Cloud. Return to the console to check whether the tools have loaded.
暂未连上小智。请检查电脑网络；若地址已失效，请从控制台重新复制，或点击下方重试。: Unable to connect to Xiaozhi yet. Check your network; if the address has expired, copy it again from the console, or retry below.
接入点已保存，正在连接小智云端…: Endpoint saved. Connecting to Xiaozhi Cloud…
可以直接使用已保存的接入点，也可以在下方更换。: Use the saved endpoint, or replace it below.
留空使用已保存的接入点，或粘贴新地址: Leave blank to use the saved endpoint, or paste a new address
粘贴完整的 wss:// 接入地址: Paste the complete wss:// endpoint address
服务启动后显示数据位置: The data location will appear when the service starts
在下方导入设备配对和固件包。: Import device pairing and a firmware package below.
后台服务启动后显示设备更新状态。: Device update status will appear when the background service starts.
已关闭小智连接，本机 MCP 继续运行: Xiaozhi disconnected. Local MCP is still running.
让常用工具访问你的本地记忆。: Give your tools access to your local memory.
开启 MCP 服务后即可使用: Available when the MCP service is on
将导出的 TOML 配置合并到 Codex 的 MCP 配置，再重新加载客户端。: Merge the exported TOML into your Codex MCP configuration, then reload the client.
支持 stdio MCP 的客户端，可使用导出的 JSON 配置添加 EvoMy: Add EvoMyn to clients that support stdio MCP using the exported JSON configuration.
配置包含本机路径。导入后保持应用在后台运行；更换电脑时重新导出。: The configuration includes local paths. Keep the app running in the background after import; export it again when switching computers.
让绑定的小智设备调用本机能力。: Let your paired Xiaozhi device use local capabilities.
登录小智控制台: Sign in to the Xiaozhi console
使用设备绑定的账号登录。: Sign in with the account linked to your device.
进入「智能体」，选择设备正在使用的角色，打开「配置角色」。: Go to Agents, select the role your device uses, and open Configure role.
在「MCP 设置」或「编辑功能」中找到「MCP 接入点」，复制完整的: Find the MCP endpoint in MCP settings or Edit features, then copy the complete
控制台菜单可能随版本调整。这里填写云端生成的接入点。: Console menus may vary by version. Enter the endpoint generated by the cloud service here.
保存后尝试连接。: A connection will be attempted after saving.
仅保存在本机，保存后不再显示。: Stored only on this computer and hidden after saving.
管理桌面偏好、本地数据与版本更新。: Manage desktop preferences, local data, and updates.
从托盘重新打开，或右键退出。: Reopen from the tray, or right-click to quit.
记忆与配置保存在这台电脑上。: Memory and configuration are stored on this computer.
配置完成后，打开应用即自动提供固件。请保持应用运行，并让电脑与设备处于同一局域网: Once configured, the app automatically serves firmware while open. Keep it running with the computer and device on the same local network; confirm installation on the device. It keeps running when minimized and stops when you quit.
导入原有运行目录中的设备配对配置，再选择可信本地固件包的 manifest.js: Import device pairing from the existing runtime directory, then select manifest.json from a trusted local firmware package. Keep its .bin file in the same directory.
默认使用 EvoMyn 的 GitHub Releases。留空保存可恢复默认地: Uses EvoMyn GitHub Releases by default. Save an empty field to restore the default URL. Only updates signed by this project are accepted.
首次启动可能需要一点时间。: The first launch may take a moment.
登录电脑后在后台启动。: Start in the background when you log in.
